title: A Girl in a Million
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A one-volume Harlequin manga adapted from a Betty Neels novel. Carol, an old-fashioned nurse, is drawn to Marius, an older and sophisticated man she meets on holiday, and is startled when he turns up working at her hospital. MangaUpdates tags point to a doctor-nurse romance with childcare elements.
life_message: Steady character and quiet devotion in caring work win lasting love.

content.note: Publisher calls the holiday attraction a 'fling' out of character for her; no sexual content noted (to verify).
